pdf_note: copy of research/sources/hurrell.pdf (open access, CC BY); plot is an embedded raster image

x_axis.note: left and right frame lines at slip 0 and 60 percent

y_axis.note: bottom frame line and top grid row

marker.identification: manual seeds for red + markers (experiment), refined to the error bar midpoint

meta.source_title: Traction Performance Evaluation for a Rashid-1 Rover Wheel (Hurrell et al.; Space Science Reviews 221:37, 2025)
meta.vehicle: single wheel testbed with a model of the Rashid-1 rover wheel (closed on one side)
meta.grousers: 14 grousers, 20 mm long (flight wheel: 15 mm, skeletonised)
meta.soil: Toyoura sand, loose (about 25 percent relative density)
meta.preparation: loose packing checked with a hand vane against calibrated bulk density samples
meta.comparability_note: Seed pixels read by eye for the red + experiment markers, refined automatically to the column of the vertical error bar and the midpoint of that bar (error bars are symmetric about the mean); error bar half lengths are not transcribed. Forced slip on level loose Toyoura sand at wheel speed 0.2 rad/s, Earth gravity, nominal 24.5 N per wheel for the 10 kg Rashid-1 rover. Toyoura sand is a uniform laboratory quartz sand (0.15 to 0.3 mm), close in grain size to fine dune sand but better sorted.
